name: shopify
description: Manage Shopify store data including products, orders, customers, and inventory. Connects to a store's Admin GraphQL API using a custom app access token.

SHOPIFY_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: Shopify Admin API access token (starts with shpat_). Create a custom app in your Shopify admin under Settings → Apps → Develop apps.

MYSHOPIFY_DOMAIN.description: Your Shopify store domain, e.g. your-store.myshopify.com
